Kaee log esaaaeepi yani sistamaitik investament plan men nivesh karte hain. lekin bite kuchh vakt se sheyar market men chal rahe utar-charhav ke daur ne logon ko uljhan men bhi dala hai. kaee yuva job shuru karne ke sath hi bachat aur nivesh ke bare men sochne lagte hain. aise men esaaaeepi chhote nivesh ka ek tarika hai. lekin kya esaaaeepi men nivesh surakshit hai aur kya jen-zi abhi esaaaeepi men nivesh kar fayde men rah sakte hain ya unhen nuqsan uthana par sakta hai?
Riport tejasvi sinh
Aavaz navin negi
Vidiyo editing sumit vaid
